description: Land Acquisition - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1911/11 of 23.04.2015, Munnessaram Pattuwa, Chilaw D/S Division, Puttalam District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices for acquiring specific land parcels for public purposes, including descriptions of individual lots, claimants, and land characteristics. The content falls squarely under "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes) and does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any other specialized category.
